kpis.name: Day-ahead boomless-Mach error
kpis.source: 3,500 IGRA2 launches, 12 stations (US, mountain, Alaska, Europe), Oct 2025 – Sep 2026, 24 h forecasts (engine/validate.py, study/results/validation_ifs.json)
kpis.note: Model 2.9: mean of GFS and ECMWF IFS. RMS 0.0117 at 24 h, 0.0104 at 6 h, 0.0092 analysis (GFS alone 0.0130, 0.0113, 0.0104 on the same launches). Unsafe side only (model allows more than the balloon): 0.0095 at 24 h and 0.0080 at 6 h, under the 0.010 gate if the gate is measured on the unsafe side (owner's decision, Method 6.2). Mountain stations ~20% worse (margin raised there)

phases.name: Precise
phases.gate: Day-ahead error <= 0.010 vs balloons; boom exposure <= 0.5% of flights at the default margin

phases.name: Loudness
phases.gate: Reproduces sBOOM reference cases within 5%; FaINT caustic data within its scatter
